name: 25265-longprompt-kimilinear48b-tp8
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, unquantized, ungated on HF. ~49 B parameters, ~3 B active per token, ~12.3 GB per card at TP8. Not interchangeable: run this exact checkpoint.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, one node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1. No expert parallelism, no speculative decoding, no context parallelism, no disaggregation.
architecture: KimiLinearForCausalLM, 27 layers -- 20 Kimi Delta Attention (linear, recurrent) and 7 MLA -- sparse MoE with 256 routed experts at top-8 plus one shared expert, model_max_length 1048576, no draft head.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 fixed, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 200 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, streaming, driven at `/v1/completions` with a plain string prompt. 80000 prompt tokens fixed (min == max), 16 output tokens pinned (min == max) with `ignore_eos: true`, at `temperature: 0.0`. Seed 42.
purpose: A document analyst reading 80,000-token briefs one at a time, returning short answers from a 48-billion-parameter model on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form.
# One `key: value` per line: an indented or nested block is dropped silently, so the engine
# would start without something this file claims to declare.

model-path: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 8
trust-remote-code: true
random-seed: 42

# Not a choice, but load-bearing when reading the log: sglang force-disables the radix cache for
# KimiLinearForCausalLM, so the cache-hit rate is 0 by construction and is not a defect.
